sentences.text:
Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.,Saurabh Tiwari Hon'ble Mahesh Chandra Tripathi,J.
Hon'ble Prashant Kumar,J.
1. Heard Shri Sanjay Mishra, learned counsel for the petitioner and Shri Ambrish Shukla, learned Additional Chief Standing Counsel for the State-respondents.

2. At the very outset, Shri Shukla raised an objection regarding the maintainability of the writ petition against the order impugned that the petitioner has efficacious remedy by filing an Appeal under Section 70 of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.

Satish Chandra vs State Of U.P. And 4 Others on 22 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/148504435/

sentences.text:
3. Once the efficacious remedy is available to the petitioner, we are not inclined to by-pass the statutory provisions.
4.
Accordingly, the writ petition stands disposed of, in case, any such appeal is preferred within two weeks from today definitely, the same would be considered expeditiously as per law.
